diagnostic.capture: Existing read-only audit collects source run UUID, slot, actual start/observation/completion, result-created, relay ID and disposition, coverage, and missing/suppressed flags. Append only unique allowlisted technical metadata to diagnostic branch via separately authorized monitor if available. No source content or secrets. No manual run counted.
diagnostic.missing: Latest-only access can lose samples. Denominator 20 nominal slots; explicitly list missing/unknown, no retrospective filling from inbox survivors. If fewer than 10 complete distinct exact-mode samples, descriptive only and insufficient baseline; even 20 cannot establish hard guarantee.
diagnostic.analysis: Report observed count, early count and fraction with exact binomial CI (sampling limitations), min/max/median, quartiles, phase deltas separately; no assumed IID for scheduler series; compare historical accepted packets separately as selected sample, not control. No causal inference from pre/post nonrandomized series.
diagnostic.existing_first_failure: Historical first exact-mode slot retained as known failure, not included in prospective 20-slot cohort.
